t: Free printable coding blocks that an app scans to run a Sphero robot.
steps: Find the SAS CodeSnaps page and read the lesson ideas.
Install the free app on an iPad from the App Store.
Print the coding blocks from the page.
Connect a supported Sphero robot such as BOLT, Mini, SPRK+, SPRK, Sphero, or Ollie.
Build a short program with the printed blocks and scan it.
Choose the block language that fits your class.
Try the version for visually impaired students before class.
